reasoningChain.evidence: Strengthening the ranger before the mixed shield-and-flag confluence supports progression.
The ranger is the verified mark-based physical damage leader or runner-up in every Chapter 2 fight.
The mythic gloves exceed the current gloves in physical power and stack mark strength, low-health damage, might, armor break, critical rate, and execution damage.
The current legendary gloves offer shield break and mark strength, but the mythic pair adds broader direct-damage multipliers that match the profile and the confluence's mixed targets.
